name: Kashiwagi Yuu
source:
Yuu is a new student in the school. Her onee-sama is Hatsune in the dormitory building. She has a weak constitution. She strives for rehabilitation while she develops rapport with Hatsune and Chihaya, and she gets better little by little. She calls Chihaya "Tenshi-sama" which stands for "Angel".

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru_characters#Otome_wa_Boku_ni_Koishiteru:_Futari_no_Elder]Wikipedia[/url].]
